blurb: AreaBFE offers guided and self-driven off-road adventures on a private 320-acre park and Moab's legendary terrain. Guests can drive their own vehicles or ride along in professional guided tours featuring technical rock crawling, scenic overlooks, and historic sites. Tours range from mild family-friendly rides to extreme rock crawling experiences.
extraNote: Custom route tailored to group experience and vehicle capabilities · Guide adjusts pace and obstacles to group comfort level
